attachments.document_title: Letter or message dismissing with immediate effect
attachments.label: A1
must_show: that employment ends with immediate effect
attachments.text:
Feldegg Services Ltd
Schaffhausen

Schaffhausen, 16 April 2026

Termination of employment with immediate effect

We hereby terminate the employment relationship with immediate effect as of today.

Please return all keys, documents and equipment belonging to the company before leaving the premises. The final salary statement will follow by post. Personal belongings can be collected from reception by arrangement.

Feldegg Services Ltd

Jack Turner
Managing Director

attachments.document_title: Employment contract or other record of its terms
attachments.label: A2
attachments.text:
FIXED-TERM EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT

between
Feldegg Services Ltd, Schaffhausen, represented by Jack Turner, Managing Director (employer)
and
Ben Kaufmann, Birkenweg 75, Schaffhausen (employee)

1. Duration: The employment begins on 26 June 2023 and is concluded for a fixed term. It ends on 30 June 2026.

2. Position: Field service technician, full-time.

3. Salary: CHF 2,860 gross per month.

4. Working hours: 42 hours per week.

Schaffhausen, 12 June 2023

For the employer: J. Turner
The employee: B. Kaufmann

questions.label: Q1
questions.question: Did the employer end the employment relationship with immediate effect, without a notice period?

questions.label: Q2
questions.question: Was the employment relationship agreed for a fixed term, with an agreed end date, rather than for an unlimited period?

questions.label: Q3
questions.question: Did the employee ask the employer to state the reasons for the immediate dismissal in writing?

questions.label: Q4
questions.question: Has the employee earned income from other work during the time the notice period or the agreed term would still have run?

questions.label: Q5
questions.question: Does the file say that a written individual employment contract, a standard employment contract or a collective employment contract sets notice periods different from the statutory ones (seven days during probation, art. 335b para. 1; one month in the first year of service, two months in the second to ninth years, three months thereafter)?

questions.label: Q6
questions.question: Does the employer give as the cause of the dismissal the employee's absence from work, and does the employee say they were prevented from working through no fault of their own (for instance illness, accident or a non-voluntary legal obligation)?

text:
Hello,

Feldegg Services Ltd in Schaffhausen fired me on 16 April 2026 with immediate effect. Jack Turner, the managing director, gave me a letter in the morning, told me to collect my things and walk out. No notice period, no last day, nothing. Laura Odermatt from the office had to escort me to the exit, and she looked as embarrassed as I felt.

I've attached my contract with them.

I didn't ask Mr Turner to explain his reasons in writing. I was angry and I simply wanted to get out of there, and since then I haven't been in touch with him at all.

What makes it worse is that my contract had a fixed end. I started on 26 June 2023 and the contract was agreed to run until 30 June 2026. So it would have ended in a couple of months anyway, and I had already planned for that. Instead I lost the last two and a half months of pay from one day to the next, at CHF 2,860 a month.

Mr Turner's letter is attached as well.

Can they just end a fixed contract early like this? And what can I ask them to pay me?

Regards,
Ben Kaufmann
Birkenweg 75, Schaffhausen
